description: This file defines the 'Language' controller class within the OpenCart admin localization module. It manages CRUD operations, listing, enabling/disabling, deleting, and generating language data.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class for managing localization languages in OpenCart admin panel. Handles listing, editing, creating, deleting, enabling/disabling, and generating language data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying language list and related UI components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calls getList to render the language list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for displaying list of languages with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays form for adding or editing a language.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving or updating a language, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected languages, with permission validation.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected languages, with permission validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected languages after validation, ensuring no dependencies.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a JSON file of all languages for frontend use, with permission check.
